scenario_steps.name: the 3D Model Modify panel's unpinned additional command area is open
the user clicks the Simplification panel expansion arrow
the Modify additional command area closes
the Simplification additional command area opens
it displays "Remove Details", "Fill Voids", and "Define Envelopes"
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport
the Simplification additional command area closes
the part and 3D Model ribbon remain visible
